steps.title: Where your review goes
steps.body: Submit Review copies the review and your annotations together. The agent receives the context in one paste.

steps.title: Make the confirmation more specific
steps.body: Say explicitly that the review was copied to the clipboard. This is a wording-only proposal; the submission behavior stays the same.
steps.diff:
-vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage('Review submitted and copied', 2000)
+vscode.window.setStatusBarMessage('Review copied to clipboard', 2000)

steps.title: Keep the review after submission
steps.body: Submitting does not clear responses or approvals. You can return to the walk and continue the conversation.
